basis: Andrew, 25 Oct 2026, on the items Coates' delivery dockets name that our record did not hold: "yes onsite please add" - the P05 microwave, the CP1 fridge and urn, the P09 boiling-water unit, and the laserplane (1065384) on the plant contract. Through the page's own controls, as an editor would: the four building items attached through each drawer's Attach form with their numbers; the laserplane added as a new reference through the page's Add form (as EQ0001-EQ0005 were), filed under Other so it is not counted among the forklifts and access machines, its contract line as its note and branch MEAD, its quantity 1 and 1 of 1 received, its light on site and Complete ticked. Nothing else changes.
